tei:div.tei:p: mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyang ba/ /de ring tshig gi rin chen gyi/ /gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis

| | bdag la nges par dbang bskur cig /ces lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas sngar bzhin du slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas su bcug la/ gsum pa'i dus su myong ba'i bzhi pa'i ye shes 'od gsal gyi rjes la 'byung ba'i zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis zung 'jug gi rang bzhin mtshon pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis tshig gis ngo sprad par bya ste/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med pas mnyam pa nyid/ / rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes brjod nas donabashad de/ 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug nas/ so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes tshul bzhin du skyes pa'i mthar/ sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa sgom du gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs pa phye la/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par byas nas/ zung du 'jug pa'i lam bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so zhes brda sprad nas/ zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa la slob tu gzhug go /dbang bzhi pa'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o || || dam tshig bsdus te khas blang dang*/ /yon 'bul ba gnyis slob ma'i las | | dkyil 'khor mchod dang dngos grub blang*/ /bzod par gsol dang lhag chad bskang*/ /smon lam gdab dang gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing phur bu dbyung*/ /bdag nyid yongs su bsrung ba ste/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnam pa bcu/ /de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis gang ji skad gsungs pa thams cad bsgrub pa'i bsam pas/ snga ma bzhin du lan gsum du dam bca'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba las/ /bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags/

/ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu'ang stsal/ / sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa stsal/ /zhes tshig gi gtang rag phul nas/ dngos su ci 'byor pa'i yon dang*/ yid kyis kyang lus dang longs spyod dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gong du brjod pa'i tshig lan gsum brjod pas dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ phyi dang gsang ba dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad nye bar gnang bar gsol ba btab la/ chad pa'am ni lhag pa'i tshig / bdag gis brjod dang gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs mdzad pa// mgon po khyod kyis bzod par gsol/ /ma rnyed pa dang ma shes pa/ /ma nus pa yang bzod par mdzod/ /ma tshang ba'am 'gal bgyis pa/ /de kun bzod pa mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ nongs pa spyad pa bzod par gsol nas lhag chad kyi nyes pa bskang ba'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am | ma 'grub na yi ge brgya pa yang nas yang du brjod par bya'o/ /de nas las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad bder gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba'i/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces bya ba la sogs pa shin tu rgya che ba'i smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /de nas spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa la dmigs te/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i mthar oṃ badzra muḥzhes brjod nas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus nas/ a kā ro'i mthar/ oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yas pa'i srin lag gis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig la/ rdul tshon ma lus par bsdus la rin po che'i snod du bzhugs nas/

rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo chen por dor bar bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bcur btab pa'i rdo rje phur bu rnams mchod nas/ g.yon brkyang pa yi stabs kyis gnas/ /skam pa'i phyag rgyas phyogs bcu ru/ /gnas pa yi ni phur bu dag /gsang sngags brjod cing dbyung bar bya/ /oṃ badzra kī la/ utkī la ya sarba bighnan badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ho/ zhes gsungs pa ltar phyung nas/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag pa la dri'i chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ satwa arthaṃ/ a mu ka sya shāntiṃ ku ru swa sti swā hā zhes brjod nas/ phur bu'i ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas thams cad ba byung gis legs par byugs nas/ rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ gnod mdzes kyi sngags brjod cing yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum mngon par bsrungs nas dga' ston chen po la longs spyod cing ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni dbang gi bya ba yongs su rdzogs te/ thog mar smin par byed pa rgyu'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas bla mas dam tshig dang sdom pa rgyas par sbyin zhing*/ slob mas de la bslabs pas dbang gi dam tshig dang ye shes mi nyams par byas shing*/ rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa bstan pa la bslabs pas/ dbang gi don goms shing rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa ni grol bar byed pa'i lam yin la/ de nyid dbang gi don nyams su len pa'i phyir lam gyi dbang yin no/ /goms pa mthar son pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te gshegs nas/ dbang bskur ba mdzad pa'i tshe phyi dang nang gi mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa 'di ni 'bras bu'i dbang yin te/ dbang gsum gyis rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos ma lus pa yongs su bsdus pa yin no/

/zab cing rgya che rnam par bkod legs 'dus pa'i rgya mtshor rgyud sde'i klung*/ /bye ba phrag brgya kun nas 'dus pa shin tu gzhal bar dka' ba'i klong | | klu sgrub klu yi dbang pos dbang mdzad des bkod bstan bcos rin chen gling*/ /man ngag nor bus cher bkra las 'ongs dbang rab gsal ba bdag gis gleng*/ /'di 'dra'i tshul la tshul bzhin rab 'dun rnam dpyod blo yi dbyig ldan pa/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya bas yang nas yang du rab bskul bas/ /bdag gis sbyar mod tshu rol mthong ba byis pa'i blo yi ngang tshul bas/ /'di la 'gal gang de la de ltar gzigs pa rnams kyis bzod par dgongs/ /dge ba gang zhig nye bar bskrun pas ma lus 'gro ba'ang dbang 'di yis/ /gang dag ji bzhin smin par byas nas kun nas dge ba'i rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor mchog gis tshogs gnyis dpal rab rab tu rdzogs nas srid zhi'i dpal/ /sku gnyis zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid gyur cig/ // dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyidakyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul/ slob dpon bdag nyid chen po mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje can/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas 'ongs pa | grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon klu'i byang chub dang*/ slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsal bar mdzad pa'i cho ga dang mthun par/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas/ chos kyi rje mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po nyid kyis nos pa las thob cing*/ thob pa bzhin du gsal bar byas pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'gro ba'i bla ma de nyid kyi zhabs kyi padma la gus pas gtugs pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ chu pho khyi'i lo/ smal po'i zla ba la | rgyal po'i pho brang kha'i phing hur zhes bya bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su

rdzogs sa ོ//gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ ind+ra bhū ti/ rgya mtsho klu'i dbang po/(《 zha 》+ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i ) klu las byung ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ārya de wa/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje | skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ pra bha ka ra de wa/ dharmā ka ra shānti/ bikṣa ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ bla ma chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bar du'o// //༄༅/ /gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs kyi rnam thar dang brgyud pa'i rim pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / sngon byung ba rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul/ o ḍi bi sha zhes bya bar rgyal po bi su kalpa zhes bya ba byung ste/ de sangs rgyas la dad pas nyan thos dang theg pa chen po'i chos mang du mnyan yang*/ 'di las kyang ches zab pa'i chos gzhan yod grang snyam du sems shing 'khod pa'i tshe/ mtshan gcig gi rmi lam du bud med gcig na re/ 'di nas nub byang gi mtshams na au ḍi ya na zhes bya ba yod kyis der song shig dang*/ skye ba 'dir rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas gnyid sad ma thag tu | au ḍi yan gyi phyogs su phyin pa dang*/ der sleb nas sngar rmi lam du byung ba dang 'dra ba'i bud med zhig dang phrad pas/ 'di ni sprul pa'o snyam nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur byas nas/ bdag rjes su gzung bar zhu zhes zhus nas gsol ba btab pas/ des dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa bshad pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnang ngo*/ /rgyal po des kyang 'bad pa byas pas dngos grub brnyes te/ des 'dzam bu'i gling du sa ra ha la sogs pa la spel nas/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa rnams kyang de'i rjes su byung ngo*/

/zhes grag go | phyis byung ba slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgya gar shar lho'i yul (《 lu 》 mtshams ) sindhu ra zhes bya bar/ rgyal po gha pa ru pra bha wa zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs so/ /de'ang byis pa nyid nas gzugs dang*/ shes rab dang kun tu spyod pa rnam par dag par gyur nas sgra dang sdeb sbyor dang*/ lugs kyi bstan bcos la sogs pa la rab tu mkhas par sbyangs so/ /cher skyes pa dang rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor nas/ na lend+ra'i phyogs gcig tu grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya bar/ rgyal po shrī dharma pā la zhes bya bas brtsigs pa tri ka dhru zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du mang pos bkur ba'i sde par gtogs pa/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du mas mdzes pa/ mkhan po rnam par snang mdzad bzang po zhes bya ba'i slob ma'i mchog thugs rje dang byang chub kyi sems la rab tu goms pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rab tu gzhol ba/ gzhung lugs du ma'i pha rol tu son cing bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab du ma'i mdzod 'dzin la/ bye brag tu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don gsal bar 'chad pa/ slob dpon bdag nyid chen po seng ge bzang po zhes bya ba mnyes par byas nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung lugs mang du gsan cing mkhyen par mdzad nas/ bram ze'i rigs kyi dge slong ma yon tan bshes gnyen gyi don du sdud pa'i 'grel pa yang mdzad la/ gzhan yang 'chad pa dang rtsom pa'i bya ba mang du mdzad do/ /de nas yul dbus nas nub byang du dpag ∶tshad sum brgya (《 lu 》 nyis brgya sum bcu ) bgrod pa na/ au ḍi ya na zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa der byon nas/ nor bu gling du sku 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon phyag rgya chen po grub pa dpal sna tshogs gzugs can zhes kyang grags la/ gsang mtshan sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i drung du bzhugs nas/

gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du mar dbang bskur ba yang nos la/ rgyud sde mang po yang gsan no/ /de nas yang de nyid kyi phyogs shig na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i man ngag thob pa rnal 'byor pa gu ru zhes bya ba las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dbang bskur dang*/ rgyud dang man ngag du ma gsan cing mkhyen par mdzad do/ /de nas yang mtshan cig gi mnal lam du au ḍi yan gyi byang phyogs na rigs ngan gyi bu mo dzā ti dza ba zhes bya ba'i rigs su skyes pa rnal 'byor ma lakṣ+mī se na zhes bya ba yod kyi/ de'i drung du songs shig dang*/ khyod kyi don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes lung bstan pa thos nas sad pa'i tshe der byon nas/ de mnyes par byas te/ gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa mang du gsan no/ /de nas yang rgya gar nub phyogs dzā landha ra'i grong khyer dkon mchog 'dzin ces bya ba na/ dzambha la grub pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i slob dpon byis pa'i zhabs zhes bya ba'i drung du byon nas mnyes par byas te/ shes rab kyi rgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud dang*/ gzhung mang du gsan cing*/ mkhyen par mdzad nas nan tan du mdzad do/ /de nas yang rgya gar lho phyogs kong ka na zhes bya bar thabs kyi rgyud la rab tu mkhas pa/ ting nge 'dzin mchog dang ldan pa slob dpon chen po ba li pa ta zhes bya ba bzhugs pa la/ slob ma bram ze sa ra ha dang*/ rje'u rigs mañdzu shrī la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i 'khor yang du ma yod la/ de rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i yo byad lha mo nor rgyun mas gser man cha bcu dang*/ mu tig chun po re dang*/ karsha pa ni sum brgya sbyor ro/ /bla ma de'i drung du 'ongs (《 zha 》 byon ) nas | (《 zha 》+ dpal ) gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang yang mnos la rtsa ba'i rgyud tshar bco brgyad gsan/ bshad rgyud dang sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa du ma gsan no/

/de lta na'ang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud la dka' ba'i gnas bco brgyad byung nas/ bla ma las zhus kyang the tshom ma chod pas/ dpal rdo rje gdan du byon nas | byang chub chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' las sgra zhig byung nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod 'jam pa'i rdo rje tshol cig dang des byin gyis brlabs te/ the tshom ma lus pa bral bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa thos nas/ slob dpon ba li pa ta la zhus nas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje rgya'i yul ri bo rtse lnga la bzhugs pas der mchi bar zhus pas gnang nas/ rdo rje gdan las lam phyung ste/ byang phyogs su byon pa dang*/ ku pa'i tshal zhes bya ba'i nags mthong ba zhig na/ khang bu zhig gi drung na bud med cig dang*/ khyi mo zhig gnas pa dang*/ de dang nye ba na btsun pa zhig chos gos kyis thod byas nas zhing rmod cing 'dug pa gzigs pas/ kye ma rab tu byung ba bud med dang bcas shing zhing rmod pa 'di 'dra byung bas (《 lu 》+ sangs rgyas kyi ) bstan pa nyams so snyam du dgongs nas thugs skyo bar gyur to/ /de lta na'ang nyi ma'i gung dus la bab pas/ der byon nas bsod snyoms mdzad par dgongs pa dang*/ btsun pa de na re/ slob dpon la chos ston zo la song zer ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis bzhugs pa dang*/ btsun pa des bud med la rab tu byung ba 'di la dro drangs shig ces bsgo bas/ bud med des nya rgya khyer nas chu phran gcig la nya bshor te de btsos nas/ khyi mo'i mdun du shing lo bzhag nas chos ston drongs shig ces bsgo bas/ khyi mo skyugs pa dang*/ de sngar gyi nya dang bcas te drangs pas slob dpon gyi ched du dmigs pa'i sha dang*/ mi gtsang bar dgongs nas ma gsol lo/ /lo rgyus gzhan las ni/ bud med des bye'u mang po bsad nas sha tshod byas te/ drangs pas ma gsol ba dang*/ bud med des se gol gcig gtogs pas tshod ma las bye'u rnams 'phur te song bas/

slob dpon yang the tshom du gyur to/ /zhes grag go /de nas btsun pa de na re/ kye ma 'dzam bu gling pa zer nas/ phal pa'i zas byin zhes bsgo bas 'bras chan zho dang bcas pa drangs pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis gsol nas/ yang gshegs par dgongs pa dang*/ btsun pa de na re da 'di nas phar song yang do nub sdod sa mi rnyed kyis/ sang song shig zer ba dang bzhugs so/ /btsun pa de ni gzhan du song ngo*/ /der slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa zhal ton du bton pa dang*/ gang du slob dpon gyis mi shes pa'i sar slebs pa dang*/ bud med de mi mgu ba'am

| ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur re byas pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis 'di gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes dang ldan par nges snyam nas/ 'dis the tshom chod par 'gyur snyam du dgongs te/ phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bud med de na re ngas mi shes/ da ci'i btsun pa de (《 lu 》+ nga'i skyes pa yin pas khong ) shin tu mkhas pa yin pas de la zhus shig zer ro/ /de gar song dris pas chang nyor song zer ro/ /nam 'ong dris pas/ phyem red 'ong zer ba dang bsgugs pas phyem red chang gis bzi nas 'khyol bzhin pa 'ong ba gzigs pas/ ma dad kyang nga rgyal bcag ste phyag btsal nas bdag la gsang ba 'dus pa bshad par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur longs shig ces bsgo'o/ /bdag gis dbang bskur thob ces brjod pas/ nga nyid kyi dbang bskur thob dgos zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyis yo byad btsal nas dbang bskur zhus so/ /lo rgyus gzhan las ni karsha pa na yod pa bud med la gtad pas | bud med kyis rnam par sprul te yo byad sbyar zhes grag go /der ston ra ba'i tshes brgyad kyi mtshan mo spyil po gzhal med khang du sprul/ de'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor ∶bzhugs pa (《 lu 》 sprul nas ) mngon sum du bstan nas/ btsun pa de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du sngar gyi rnam pa de nyid kyis bzhugs nas/ slob dpon la khyod nga las dbang len nam/ dkyil 'khor las len zhes dris pas/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor yang btsun pa de nyid kyi sprul pa yin par dgongs bzhin du/ lha'i rnam pa la mos par gyur nas/ dkyil 'khor las dbang len par zhus pas/ 'o na longs shig ces gsungs nas/ dkyil 'khor las dbang yongs su rdzogs par blangs so/ /lo rgyus gzhan las ni/ dkyil 'khor las dbang len zhes zhus pas/ dkyil 'khor mi snang bar gyur nas/(《 lu 》+ dkyil 'khor nga'i sprul pa yin gsungs nas

) der dkyil 'khor btsun pas sprul par dgongs nas phyag btsal te/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin zhes pa la sogs pas bstod nas bzod par gsol zhing*/ gsol ba btab pa dang*/ tho rangs thugs ka nas dkyil 'khor spros te/ 'dzum pa mdzad nas legs zhes gsungs nas dbang bskur ba mdzad do zhes grag go /de nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i don bsdus pa zhal gyi lung la sogs pa brtsams shing*/ rgyud kyi dka' ba'i gnas thams cad rtogs par mdzad do/ /der slob dpon thugs tshim zhing mnyes nas/ da bdag gis yon zhig 'bul bar 'tshal bas/ ci bzhed ces zhus pas/ gang yang mi 'dod gsung ngo*/ /cis kyang bzhed par zhu zhes gsol bas/ 'o na nam mthong ba dang phyag 'tshal ba'i yon de phul cig gsungs nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang de nyid dam bcas nas yon phul lo/ /de nas btsun pa de'i zhal nas | khyod kyang zas kyi spyod pa dang*/ /nga la cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /gzugs can phung po rang nyid kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub mi 'gyur/ /yid ni rdo rje'i sku gyur nas// bar do nyid du grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas/ da khyod kyis bsgrub pa byas kyang | tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur gyis/ bshad pas gzhan la phan par gyis shig dang*/ bar dor grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ / der slob dpon gyis rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar ri bo'i phug ces bya ba na chos kyi myu gu zhes bya bar bzhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam pa'i dbyangs las mngon sum du dbang thob cing*/ chos ma lus pa gsan zhes pa'i sgra grags pas 'jig rten khyab nas/ rgyal po dang*/ paṇḍi ta/ slob dpon la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'dus so/ /de dag la'ang skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la dbang bskur nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dgongs pa dang*/ mthun pa'i rgyud nyid dang*/ zhal gyi lung la sogs pa gnang zhing*/ gnas gzhan dag tu'ang gshegs shing bshad pa mdzad do/

/de nas sngar gyi slob dpon ba li ta'ang byon nas chos gsan par bzhed pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis khyed nga'i slob dpon yin pas chos 'chad pa mi 'thad gsungs nas/ 'bel gtam gyis the tshom rnams chod par mdzad nas/ de'i don du sgrub pa'i thabs kun tu bzang po mdzad do/ /spyir slob dpon gyis lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad de | kun tu bzang po'i sgrub thabs/ kun tu bzang mo'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg gi cho gagator ma/ tshogs 'khor/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyis brgya lnga bcu pa/ ye shes chen po/ tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod/ grol ba'i thig le/ bdag bsgrub pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le/ dpal bshes kyi rnam bshad bzhi pa la 'jug pa/ chu sbyin gyi sgrub thabs rnams so/ /de ltar slob dpon gyis bshad pa dang*/ bstan bcos mang du mdzad pas/ slob ma dpag tu med pa byung la/ de rnams las mchog tu gyur pa ni bco brgyad yod cing | mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa bzhi yod de/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'o/ /de ltar chos kyi snang bas skye rgu'i yid snang bar mdzad cing bzhugs pa la re zhig gi tshe/ tshogs pa mang po la chos 'chad cing bzhugs pa na (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ sngar gyi bla ma btsun pa ) chang gis bzi nas (《 lu 》+ mchil lham phrag pa la bkal nas ) 'khyol bzhin pa mdun nas gshegs pa gzigs so/ /de la phyag mdzad na gzhan ma dad kyis dogs nas/ phyag ma mdzad par de mdun nas yol ba dang*/ phyi bzhin 'brangs nas byon pas/ bla ma de mchod rten zhig gi grib ma la zhabs brkyang nas bzhugs pa mthong ba dang*/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod nga la dbang gi yon du nam mthong ba na phyag 'tshal bar khas blangs nas/ de ring mi 'tshal ba ci yin/ zhes gsungs pas slob dpon gyis ma dgongs par/ bdag gis ma mthong zhes zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas sa'i snying po gatstsha zhes gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi spyan sa la lhung ngo*/ /der bzod pa gsol zhing gsol ba btab pa dang*/ rgyang grags gcig gi khor yug sgrib pa med par snang ba'i spyan gnang ngo*/ /de phyin chad ye shes kyi spyan zhes grags so/ /lo rgyus gzhan las ni/ slob dpon gyi slob ma bram ze ye shes zhabs zhes bya ba gcig la de ltar byung gi slob dpon nyid ma yin no zhes grag go /de nas yang dus gcig gi tshe/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan dang nye ba zhig na spyil po zhig mdzad nas/ sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gzhan thams cad rdo rje gdan du dus bzang la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis ma gshegs pas thams cad kyis smod par gyur pa'i gtam rgyal po dharma pā la zhes bya bas thos pas/ rgyal pos slob dpon yin par ma dgongs par mi rigs par byed pa ni/ 'di tshar gcad dgos zer nas/ rgyal pos spyil po'i nang du phyin nas bltas pas/ 'jam dpal gyi sku gcig las gzhan pa ma mthong na/ phyir byung nas nye gnas pa la dris pas bzhugs zer skad/ yang nang du phyin nas bltas pas/ slob dpon bzhugs pa mthong nas/ rdo rje gdan la phyag mi 'tshal ba ci yin byas pas/ ngas 'di nyid nas byed pa yin gsung ngo*/ /ji ltar byed dris pas | slob dpon gyis mdun du rdo rje gdan la shākya thub pa mngon sum du bzhugs pa snang bar byas nas phyag byas pas/ rgyal po ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ slob dpon la bzod par gsol zhing bla mchod du bzhugs par zhus pas/ ma gnang bar gzhan du gshegs so/ /rgyal po slob dpon gyi spyil po'i shul du sngar ji ltar mthong ba'i bkod pa byas pa'i lha khang yang byas so/ /de ltar sku des gzhan don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas 'das te/ bar dor mchog gi dngos grub grub pa yin no/ /de'i slob ma ni mar me mdzad bzang po yin la/

de nas rim pa bzhin dpal sde bi ma la gupta/ ratna badzra/ ratna kīrti/ panda pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u ba sku mched/ bla ma chos rje sa skya pa yab sras rnams la rim pa bzhin du brgyud do/ /∶gang la 'jam dbyangs nyid kyis (《 lu 》 phyis bdag gi dbang bskur ba nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ tha kha na/ bhu shā na pa/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ bhi me shan ti/ bhring ka ra sa tā/ shā dha ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ skyang po chos kyi blo gros/ gcung zhang khri/ dmyal pa rgyogs ston/ mkhun rtsi gzhon nu rin chen/ rtsang rong pa shes rab gzhon nu/ slob dpon dkon mchog mkhar/ g.yag stengs dbang phyug rin chen/ khams ston shākya rdo rje/ bla ma mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus so/ /bla ma chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje rin po che pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi ) rjes bzung ∶ba(《 lu 》 ba'i ) / /ye shes zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa dang*/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa gang yin pa/ /mthong dang thos tshul 'phags pas bris pa yin/ /sa pho rta'i lo ston zla tha chungs la rgyal bu go pe la'i pho brang du bris pa'o/ /(《 lu 》+ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'di la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i lugs gcig ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje| slob dpon sgrib pa med pas dus gsum gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs chen po/ panṭi ta mar me med mdzad bzang po/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ panṭi ta ratna a ka ra shan ti pa/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma ka ra bar ma/ sgra bsgyur gyi lo tstsha ba rin chen bzang po/ de man chad gzhan du gsal ba yin no/ /chos kyi rje rin po che pa'i phyag dpe la bris pa yin no// //maṃ ga laṃ// // ) ༄༅/ /gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/

/ ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu rnam dag ye shes rgya mtsho yon tan gter gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /gser gyi mdog mtshungs g.yas zhal mkha' dang g.yon pa zla mdangs phyag drug gi /dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud cing g.yas gnyis ral gri gsum pas mda'/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis atpal gzhu bsnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mgon po de la mchog tu dad pas de yi sgrub thabs de nyid kyis/ /rjes su bzung bas ye shes spyan ldan sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis ni/ / legs par mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas tshig nyung don ni rab gsal ba/ /sgrub thabs rin chen phreng ba 'dis ni mgrin pa brgyan phyir spel bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen por yongs su smin cing*/ bla ma las gnang ba thob pa'i sngags pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ nub mo 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal/ nangs par tho rangs kyi tshe/ bdag nyid skad cig gis thig le'i rnam par gnas pa las | thig le bzhi mtshams bzhir 'phros nas/ lha mo bzhir gyur te/ sems can gyi khams na gnas pa la sogs pa'i glus bskul te/ slar yang thig le nyid la thim nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rjer dmigs pa'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du mam̐ gyi yi ge bsams la/ de'i snang bas dri ma gsum dag par byas te/ lha'i tshogs yang dag par bkug nas de dag gis ye shes kyi chus bdag bkrus par bsam zhing dngos su khrus bya'o/ /de nas lha rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ /sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o// // de nas snga dro'i thun la 'jug pa'i phyir/ dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa brjod par bya'o/ /de'ang bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ snying rje chen po las byung ba'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas

| rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje dmigs pa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i mam̐ las 'od zer gyi tshogs lcags kyu'i rnam pa spros pas lha dang bla ma spyan drangs la mngon sum ltar dmigs te/ brjod par 'gyur ba'i don rnams dran bzhin pas | 'di skad ces/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan// dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing*/ /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rab mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod cing de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang | | 'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag rjes yi rangs/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dra bsgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ / rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*/ /sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid*/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol 'gyur zhing*/ /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab zhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur cing*/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ / lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos | | yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ /zhes re re la'ang lan gsum gsum du brjod pa'i mthar tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol lo/

/de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba dang*/ nyams pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa dang*/ chags pa dang sdang ba med pa'i tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la dgod par 'dod pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya'o/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o | | de nas rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dran par byas pa'i mthar/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ādma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams de nyid du sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthus rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ du rnam par sprul te/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bltas la/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi phung po las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang | ra ba dang*/ dra ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar bar bsam mo/ /de'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bhrūm̐ gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yangs shing rgya che bar bsam mo

| | de'i nang du dbus dang phyogs bcur padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bsams la/ so so'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bltas nas/ de dag las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ don gnyis byas nas slar 'dus te/ so so la thim nas yongs su gyur pa las 'chad par 'gyur pa'i khro bo rnams bskyed par bya'o/ /de'ang dbus su rang nyid 'jigs byed dang*/ u ma mnyam par mnan pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ phyag g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje/ gsum pas ral gri/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas zhags pa/ gsum pas lcags kyu/ shar du gshin rje gshed sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas pas tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon pas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ lhor shes rab mthar byed sku mdog dkar po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas pas dbyug to dang ral gri/ g.yon pas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma mthar byed sku mdog dmar po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas pas padma dang ral gri/ g.yon pas 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon pas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'o// byang shar du mi g.yo ba/ g.yas pas ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon pas 'khor lo dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas pas lcags kyu dang ral gri/ g.yon pas rin po che dang mda' 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dbyug pa sngon po can g.yas dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri/ g.yon pas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa | nub byang stobs po che g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang ral gri/ g.yon pas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/(《 lu 》+ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan pa/ ) steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sku mdog ser po/

zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba | g.yas pas 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon pas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes g.yas pas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon pas rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa'o/ /hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa'i khro bo bdun ni sku mdog sngon po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba yin la | rigs kyi bdag po gong du ma bstan pa rnams ni/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa yin no/ /thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'khyud pa'i tshul du mdzad cing*/ lhag ma bzhis so so'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing*/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo | | de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros nas/ khro bo rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas/ bsrung ba'i phrin las la brtson par mdzad cing*/ so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/ de'i sgra dang me'i 'od kyis bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams bskrad par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐/ gri hna gri hna hūm̐/ gri hnā pa ya gri hnā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān (《 zha 》+ badzra ) badyā rā dza hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa brjod pas bdag nyid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad las nges par bsrung bar bsam mo/ /lha bskyed pa'i sngon du 'gro ba ni 'di tsam zhig yin la/ gal te pha rol gyi sbod gtong bzlog par 'dod na/ rang nyid dbus su gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur bar bsam zhing*/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad bsgom pa gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad dang*/ bdag nyid kyi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i nang du bdag nyid kyi rnam shes hūm̐ du bsams la de'i mthar

| bsgrub bya'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsams te/ de bsrung bar bsam pa ni bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad dang*/ khro bo rnams shin tu khros pa'i tshul can/ zhal phyi rol na gzigs nas/ thugs ka nas rang rang 'dra ba'i khro bo du ma 'phros te pha rol gyi srung ma dang*/ bdag la rbad pa'i gdon rnams tshar gcad par bsam pa lha'i rnam pa'i gnad dang*/ 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor bas dgra bgegs phye mar brlag pa 'khor lo'i gnad dang uṣṇī ṣa'i sngags bzla ba sngags kyi gnad de/ gnad lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /sngags ni oṃ uṣṇā+-i ṣa badzra tsakra warti/ sarba lo ka lo kotta ra ni/ yant+ra mant+ra/ tant+ra bi sha tsurṇa/ pra yo gi ta ni/ ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi ta/∶kritta (《 zha 》 kri tan 《 lu 》 tsid tri na ma ) ni kā ri ∶ṇi pa ta ni (《 zha 》 ta/ ne tra na/ ) sarbantu/ tstshinda tstshinda/ bhinda bhinda/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ kambha ya kambha ya/ bi dhwansa ya/ bi dhwansa ya/ sha ta sa ha sra/ bi tsurṇa ya/ uṣṇī ṣa badzra tsakra warti/ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐/∶hūm̐ hūm̐ (《 zha 》《 lu 》 dhram̐ hrum̐ dhrum̐ ) hūm̐/ zhes ci nus pa bzlas pa'i mthar | bdag nyid bsrung ba'i spel tshig dang*/ dgra bgegs la'ang dmod pa'i tshig brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni rang la bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan gyi sbyor ba phyin ci log phyir bzlog pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa man ngag gi rim pa'o// // de nas lha bskyed pa'i sngon du rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i phyir/ dbus kyi khro bo zhu ba sam̐ las rdo rje sam̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las/ kun tu bzang po sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon pas padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/

zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ rin po che dang dar gyis brgyan pa bskyed la/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod de/ 'od zer gyi tshogs mngon par spros pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te gcig tu 'gyur pa las/ chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin du grub bar bsam mo/ /de'i nang du pam̐ las padma'i nang du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ lte bar bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po | bhrūm̐ gyi mtshan pa las 'od zer spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon pa rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang dar gyis brgyan par bskyed la/ yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang 'od kyi rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po rjes su chags pa'i mes/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng gi rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ dra ba dang*/ dra ba phyed pa dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ pha gu'i steng na kra ma shīrṣa'i mda' yab dang*/ rin po che'i dra ba seng ma'i pu shu yod pa/ 'og 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i steng du lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas/ kun nas dga' ba'i zur gyi mig gis lta zhing sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i rtsed 'jo'i tshul gyis mchod par byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir ka ba gnyis gnyis rim pa bzhin/ 'khor lo dang rin po che dang padma dang ral gris mtshan pa rnams kyis rin po che'i gdung zlum bteg pa'i steng na/

gdung mi mangs ris su bris pas/ dbus kyi pho brang la le tshe dgu par gsal ba'i shar dkar/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngon po/ lha snam ni gser gyi mdog tu snang ba nyid do/ /gdung gi steng du rin po che'i rang bzhin gyis phyur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ phyi rol sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags kyis brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhi dang*/ sgo khyud kyi mtshams brgyad du/ rdo rje phyed pa dang bcas pa'i zla ba tshes pas mtshan pa/ gzhan yang rgyan dang*/ lhab lhub du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang du lha'i gnas bcu dgu padma rab tu rgyas pa'i gdan rnams la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brgyad dang*/ zla ba'i dkyir 'khor bcu gcig gi gdan rnams bsam mo/ /de nas brten pa lha bskyed pa'i phyir/ gdan dbus mar nyi ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs yig ā li bcu drug phrag gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ka las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa phrag gnyis kyis mtshan pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ du gyur par bsams pa las/ 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus te gcig tu gyur pa las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga par bskyed la/ oṃ badzra ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ rdo rje'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas gsum ka yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas sngo ba g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'od kyi rig ma rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/

mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar zhing rin po ches brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa'i bdag nyid bsam zhing*/ 'dod chags las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i thabs khyad par du 'phags pas sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i go 'phang la dgod par 'dod pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las bde ba chen po'i sgra nam mkha'i khams khyab par grags pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs nas/ yab rnams rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku la thim pas/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs shing*/ bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas yum dga' bar byas | yum rnams rig ma la thim pas/ rig ma gzi brjid dang ldan zhing bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas yab mnyes par byas nas/ slar yang snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas/ zhal du zhugs/ snying khar 'dod chags chen po'i mes 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems thig le'i rnam pas yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor cig car bskyed do/ /slar yang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa la phog sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa gzhal yas khang dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par byas nas/ sems can rnams 'od zer de nyid kyis bkug zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la gnyis su med par thim nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsam mo/ /yang sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas/ sngar bzhin zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la dbang bskur bas lha rnams re re'ang phung po lnga dang

| 'byung ba bzhi dang | skye mched bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ngo bor bsam mo | | de nas bha ga'i lha rnams la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥbighnān ta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i sngags rnams bsam/ yang na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ram̐ kham̐ ham̐ bam̐ hūm̐ dzaḥ tām̐ pam̐ mam̐ lam̐ kham̐ dzi ྃām̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sa bon rnams brjod la/ bgegs mthar byed nas gtso bo'i bar rim pa bzhin spros/ re re'ang dpag tu med par gyur nas/ snod yongs su dag pa'i gzhal yas khang rnams su/ lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i tshogs su gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas/ bde ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge ho gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa spyan drangs te/ zhal du zhugs pas yongs su sbyangs pa'i gser dang dngul chu ltar 'dres nas yab yum gnyis ka zhu ste/ byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le gcig tu gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas thig le de las thig le phra mo bzhi mtshams bzhir 'phros pa las tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin/ lha mo bzhir gyur nas/ thig le las bslang ba'i phyir/ glus bskul ba ni/ spyan gyis 'di skad du/ sems can khams la gnas pa'i dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba'i yid 'ong don chen 'dod pa bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab (《 zha 》+ chen gnyen ) mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /mā ma kīs/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rab tu phan bzhed ston/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ / 'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/

/ 'jig rten dag gi don dang dgongs pa mdzad par rab tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /dga' ba'i spyod pa kun du bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid thugs brtse ba/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa rnams kyi glus bskul nas/ lha mo rnams 'od zer du gyur te/ slar thim nas yongs su gyur pa las/ mam̐ gyi yi ger gyur/ de zhu ba las ral gri chang zung la mam̐ gyis mtshan par bltas la/ de las 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku du ma spros pas/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje gser btso ma'i kha dog dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas sngo ba g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dang gzhu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ yum gyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ni yab dang 'dra ba'o/ /gnyis ka'ang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas gnas pa

| sprul pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro bar bsams la/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas yab yum gnyis ka'i mig la sogs pa'i gnas su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ mig tu kṣi las sa'i snying po dkar po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba | phyag g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo rdo rje padma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu rin po che ral gri 'dzin pa/ rna bar dzrīṃ las phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje rin chen 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu padma ral gri 'dzin pa/ snar kham̐ las nam mkha'i snying po ser po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rin po che rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu padma ral gri 'dzin pa/ lce la lam̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na padma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu rin po che ral gri 'dzin pa/ lus la kam̐ las sgrib pa rnam sel ljang gu/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu padma nor bu 'dzin pa/ yid sam̐ las kun tu bzang po sngon po/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje padma 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu rin po che ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje sngon po/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje ral gri mda'/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu utpa la gzhu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa las/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med dang mtshungs pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa/ thams cad kyi rgyan dang cha lugs ni gtso bo dang mtshungs pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa/

thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la rang rang gi phyag mtshan la so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa bsam mo/ /nye bar sgrub pa'o/ /de nas thugs rdo rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas/ sprul pa rnams dang lhan cig bzhugs par bsams la/ bdag nyid kyi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod nas/ thugs rdo rje rnams kyi thugs kar thim par bsams la/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa la sogs pas (《 zha 》 + ye shes pa la ) gsol ba btab pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas | | deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /rdo rja ེ thugs kyi mdzad du gsol// zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba btab pas/ sprul pa dang ye shes pa'i thugs rdo rje'i tshogs thams cad bdag nyid kyi snying ga'i thugs rdo rje la thim nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de bzhin du mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje'i thugs ka'i āḥlas sprul pa'i spro bsdu dang | ye shes pa spyan drang ba dang*/ mchod pa sngar bzhin byas la/ dpal ldan chos kyi gsung mnga' ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sprul pa la gsol ba btab pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ye shes pa la gsol ba btab pas/ sprul pa dang ye shes pa rnams rang gi mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje la thim nas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi rang bzhin du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la byin gyis brlab bo/ /de bzhin du spyi bo'i sku rdo rje'i thugs ka'i oṃ las sprul pa'i spro bsdu dang*/ ye shes pa spyan drang ba dang*/ mchod pa sngar bzhin du byas la/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje sku yis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes sprul pa la gsol ba btab pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /la sogs pas ye shes pa la gsol ba btab pas/ sprul pa dang ye shes pa rnams rang gi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje la thim nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i rang bzh-in du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la byin gyis brlab bo/ / sgrub pa'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi snying gar zla ba'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mam̐ gyi yi ger bltas la/ de las 'od zer gyi tshogs spros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ sa bon las spros pa'i sprul pa'i lha mo me tog ma la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa dpag tu med pas (《 lu 》+ mngon par ) mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ dbang bskur ba'i lha dang bcas pa ro gcig tu gyur pa las | yab yum gnyis ka la rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /sgrub pa chen po'o/ /dang por sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ brla gnyis la hā'i yi ge bsam/ yum gyi bha ga a las padma dmar po/ 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga dang ldan pa/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par bsgoms la/ thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa las dga' ba gsum po sngon du song ba'i bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas bde ba chen po'i sgra sbyor mtshams nas grag pas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'dod chags chen po'i mes 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'phros/ yum gyi mkhar thig le bcu dgur gyur/ de las sa bon de yongs su gyur pa las lha bcu dgu bskyed do/ /de nas dbyung ba ni bha ga'i dbus kyi gtso bo la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ gtso bo phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can ∶gyi (《 zha 》《 lu 》 thams cad kyi ) don byas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus nas rang la thim nas/ bdag nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje gzi brjid mtha' yas pa dang ldan par bsam mo/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad la dmigs nas/ oṃ ā:dzi na dzika hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dbyung/ dpag tu med par gyur/ de spros pas sems can thams cad kyi gti mug sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ shar gyi padma dang zla ba'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/

g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas rin chen 'byung ldan la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥratna dhṛka hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la/ dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi ser sna sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ lho phyogs kyi padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gyis padma dang 'khor lo 'dzin par bsam mo/ / de nas 'od dpag tu med pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro lika hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyangs/ so sor rtog ba'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig du gyur nas/ nub phyogs kyi padma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa dmar po/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gyis 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas don yod grub pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥpra dzñā dhṛka hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros | sems can rnams kyi phrag dog sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ byang phyogs kyi padma dang nyi ma'i steng du don yod grub pa ljang gu/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon gyis padma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'khyud pa'i tshul/ rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad gtso bo dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ /de nas sangs rgyas spyan la dmigs la | oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la / dpag tu med pa spros / sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa dang*/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod/

slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ shar lhor padma dang ∶nyi ma'i (《 zha 》《 lu 》 zla ba'i ) steng du sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas mā ma kī la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje dang stobs la bkod | slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ lho nub tu padma dang zla ba'i steng du mā ma kī sngon mo/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dang ral gri/ g.yon gyis padma dang nor bu 'dzin par bsam mo | | de nas gos dkar mo la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la/ dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba dang smon lam la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ nub byang du padma dang zla ba'i steng du gos dkar mo dmar mo/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon gyis 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas sgrol ma la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥbadzra ra ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la/ dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms dang ye shes la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ byang shar du padma dang zla ba'i steng du sgrol ma ljang gu | zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dang ral gri/ g.yon gyis padma dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas gzugs rdo rje ma la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzri nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi ser sna'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod/

slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ shar lhor padma dang ∶nyi ma'i (《 zha 》 zla ba'i ) steng du gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas na me long dang ral gri/ g.yon na rin po che dang padma 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas sgra rdo rje ma la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥshapda badzri nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi tshul khrims 'chal ba sbyangs/ tshul khrims la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ lho nub tu padma dang zla ba'i steng du sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas na pi waṃ dang ral gri/ g.yon na padma dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas dri rdo rje ma la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥgandha badzri nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi khong khro sbyangs/ bzod pa la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ nub byang du padma dang zla ba'i steng du dri rdo rje ma ser mo/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar (《 zha 》 dkar ) ba/ phyag g.yas na dri'i chus yongs su gang ba'i dung chos dang ral gri | g.yon na padma dang 'khor lo 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas ro rdo rje ma la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥr sa badzri nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros | sems can rnams kyi le lo sbyangs/ brtson 'grus la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ byang shar du padma dang zla ba'i steng du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na ro brgya pas yongs su gang ba'i snod dang ral gri/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas reg rdo rje ma la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥsparṣe badzri nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi rnam g.yeng sbyangs/ bsam gtan la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ shar sgo'i g.yon logs su padma dang zla ba'i steng du reg rdo rje ma ljang gu/

zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na lha'i na bza' dang ral gri/ g.yon na padma dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /de nas chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu badzri nī hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa sbyangs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ shar sgo'i g.yas su padma dang zla ba'i steng du chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas na chos kyi 'byung gnas dang ral gri/ g.yon na padma dang rin po che 'dzin par bsam mo/ /lha mo de dag thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rab tu zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ lang tsho la bab cing nu ma rgyas pa dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs shing*/ rin po che du ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan bar blta'o/ /de nas gshin rje mthar byed/ shes rab mthar byed/ padma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed la dmigs la/ oṃ āḥya mānta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradzñānta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ ā:padmānta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams brjod nas rim pa bzhin phyung la dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can rnams kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur nas/ shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhir padma dang nyi ma'i gdan rnams la/ gshin rje mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams su gyur par bsam ste/ kha dog dang phyag mtshan ni srung 'khor gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /gtso bo ni dngos kyi rig ma dang bcas pa yin la

| gzhan lha yab kyi rnam pa rnams ni rang snang gi rig ma dang bcas pa yin zhing | lha mo rnams kyang rang snang gi yab dang bcas pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ de dag gi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' so so'i sa bon gyi yi ge bsam mo/ /bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas lha rnams kyi skye mched dang*/ lus ngag yid lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje gsum du mos par byas te gong du brjod pa bzhin no/ /nye bar bsgrub pa'o/ /yang lha rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' sa bon rnams las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' gang bas yongs su bskor ba spyan drangs la bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas bgegs mthar byed la sogs pa'i khro bo bzhi spros nas/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod pas ye shes pa'i rjes su bgegs mi 'brang bar bya'o// slar yang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs sprul nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa'i sngags kyis mchod la/ gong du spros pa'i khro bo bzhis lcags kyu | zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pas ye shes pa dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya rim pa bzhin bcings nas/ oṃ āḥya mānta kṛta dzñā na maṇḍa la ā karṣa ya dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradzñānta kṛta dzñā na maṇḍa la pra be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadmānta kṛta dzñā na maṇḍa la bandha bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ bighnānta kṛta dzñā na maṇḍa la ba shaṃ ku ru hoḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par byas la rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor nye bar bkug la/ gong du bstan pa'i tshul gyis mngon par mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa spros nas/ rigs lngas bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur | rig ma bzhis bkra shis kyi glu blangs/ lha mo drug gis mchod/ khro bo bzhis bgegs bskrad par bsam mo/ /de'i tshe lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang | dṛ ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas dbang gi lha rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur nas/ lha rnams la dbur brgyan par ∶blta'o(《 zha 》 bsam mo/ ) /de'ang yab rigs lnga la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ sangs rgyas spyan/ gshin rje gshed/ gzugs rdo rje la rnam snang*/ mā ma kī shes rab mthar byed/ sgra rdo rje la mi bskyod pa/ dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gos dkar mo/ padma mthar byed/ ro rdo rje la 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma la bgegs mthar byed/ reg rdo rje la don yod grub pa/ chos kyi dbyings rdo rje la/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'o/ /sgrub pa chen po'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer spros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i longs spyod kyi khyad par rnams bkug bdag gi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs/ sku yongs su gang*/ yab yum bde bas tshim par byas nas/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas/ 'od zer gyi tshul du 'phros pa'i rtser/ me tog ma la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas/ phyi/ nang*/ gsang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas/ bdag dang lha'i tshogs rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya'o | | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas dngos su bdud rtsi yod pa'am/ med na'ang sems kyis gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi de/

lha mo rnams kyis bdag dang lha rnams la mchod pas/ bdud rtsi'i ro myang zhing bde bas rgyud gang bar bsam/ dngos su yod na myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /yang lha mo de rnams kyis/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes pa la sogs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mngon par bstod par bsam zhing*/ ngag du brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams bdag nyid kyi snying gar bsdus nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang la rang bzhin med pa/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la dmigs pa gtad de/ mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas las rgyal mchog gi thog mar phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la gnyis las/ steng gi sbyor ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer spros/ 'jig rten gsum po ma lus pa bkug nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i mam̐ gyi ∶yi ge'i (《 zha 》《 lu 》 thig le'i ) nang du/ son nas yungs dkar gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par lhag par mos par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor de la dmigs pa gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag go /de la sems brtan nas spro bsdu'i dmigs pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od byung*/ 'khor gyi lha rnams gsal gdab/ lha rnams las 'od byung*/ mam̐ gyi yi ge gsal bar byas/ mam̐ las 'od byung bas/ ye shes sems dpa' gsal bar byas/ tshul de bzhin du thugs rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje/ sku rdo rje rnams gsal bar byas/ yang sku rdo rje las 'od byung bas/ gsung*/ thugs/ ye shes sems dpa' mam̐ gyi yi ge phra mo'i lha tshogs rnams gsal bar byas nas 'od rnams 'dus te/ gtso bo'i thugs kar thim par bsams la sems gzung ngo

| | de nas yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas sngar bzhin/ sku'i rdo rje'i bar gsal bar byas/ yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas byung*/ yum gyi mkhar zhugs | yum gyi sku rdo rje'i bar/ sngar bzhin gsal bar byas nas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od 'phros/ rags pa'i lha rnams gsal bar byas/ yang 'od rnams rim pa bzhin bsdus/ phra mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ lha rnams yum rnams la thim/ yum yab la/ yab kyang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ rim gyis stong par gyur par bsams la/ sems mnyam par bzhag go /stong gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin mchog skye'o/ /'og sgo'i sbyor ba ni/ yab yum gnyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs | snying gar zhu/ a ba dhū tī'i mar rtser thig le yungs 'bru tsam bde ba'i rang bzhin can zhig bsams la sems gzung ngo*/ /de la goms pas byang chub kyi sems brtan pa'i rtags su/ lus bde bas khyab pa dang*/ thig le mi nyams par 'byung la/ brtan pa dang thig le de yum gyi mkhar phab nas/ de'i nang du lha bcu dgu lhag par mos par byas la/ 'od kyi spro ba dang bsdu ba sngar bzhin du bya'o | | bde gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin mchog skye'o/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de dag gi skyon/ rgod pa'i gnyen por rlung gi sbyor ba la brten te sems gzung ba ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas | rim pa bzhin rdo rje'i lam nas byung*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las/ mi bskyod par gyur pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ bsams pa la de la dmigs te rlung kha sbyor bya | yid mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bying ba'i gnyen por bzlas pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ phra mo'i gtso bo'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spros nas/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang sbyar la oṃ/ gnas pa dang āḥphyir dbyung ba dang sbyar la hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar bsam gtan gyi bya bas yid skyo bar gyur na/ spyi bo'i steng du oṃ gyi yi ge bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas oṃ la thim/ oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs nas/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bas/ bde ba chen po skyes par bsam zhing mnyam par bzhag go /sems kyi skyo ba bsal nas ni/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas lha'i bzlas pa la sogs pa la 'jug par 'dod na/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis glus bskul nas/ rang ting nge 'dzin gyis langs la bya ba rnams la 'jug go /de nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha so so'i thugs kar sa bon rnams kyi mtha' mar sngags kyi yi ges bskor bar bltas la/ de las 'od zer spros/ sems can rnams kyi don byas/ slar 'dus yi ge rnams la thim pa/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bya zhing*/ gong du brjod pa'i 'byin pa'i sngags nyid bzla'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha thun mong ba'i bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐ zhes bzla'o | | bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni/ legs par bshams pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ spros/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha' gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dmigs la/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ yang 'od zer rim pa bzhin spros pas/ rim pa bzhin me'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ thod pa gsum gyi sgyed pu'i steng du/

yangs shing rgya che ba'i thod pa dpral ba bdag la phyogs pa'i nang du zla ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐ las dri chu/ shar du bhūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor ām̐ las byang chub kyi sems/ nub du dzrīṃ las khrag chen po/ byang du kham̐ las klad pa/ yang dbus su nṛ las mi'i sha shar lhor lam̐ las glang po che'i sha lho nub du mam̐ las ba lang gi sha nub byang du pam̐ las rta'i sha byang shar du tām̐ las khyi'i sha de nas yang hūm̐ las byung ba'i 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos nas me rab tu sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/ spris ma'i tshul du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ steng gi rdo rje la reg pas/ rdo rje las kyang 'od zer du ma 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas rdo rje la zhugs/ rdo rje sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ thod pa'i nang du lhung nas/ thams cad yang dag par 'dres pa las/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'dod pa'i longs spyod du mas brgyan pa/ kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang nas yang du brjod nas byin gyis brlab bo | | slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mchod yon dang*/ padma'i gdan phul la/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐/ zhes pa la sogs pa/ lha so so'i sngags kyi phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes pa'i sngags kyis 'jig rten pa rnams la'ang dbul lo/ /slar yang me tog la sogs pas mchod nas mngon par bstod la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/ phul du byung ba'i dngos grub stsal bar bsams la/ bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes brjod nas gshegs su gsol lo/ /gtor ma'i rim pa'o/ /de nas kha zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ bza' btung gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rjer bsams pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su lhag par mos la/ lte bar rab tu 'bar ba'i me a'i rnam par bsam zhing*/ mgrin par hrīḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa sbu gu dang bcas pa/ lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs/ kha hom khung du bsams la chags sdang med par lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' bar bya'o | | lhag ma ni lhag ma la dga' ba'i 'byung po la sbyin no/ /zas kyi cho ga'i rim pa'o/ /de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i rnam pa dag pa ngag tu brjod cing dran par byas pa'i mthar/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis gzhal yas khang dang lha rnams rang la bsdus nas | rang dpa' bo gcig par gnas pa'i skye mched dang lus ngag yid lha so sor mos par byas la/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi 'jig rten lhag pa'i lhar blta zhing*/ yul drug lha mo drug tu bsams la yul gyi lha mos bdag gi skye mched kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam zhing*/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod la mngon par chags pa dang*/ sdang ba'i yid rnams spangs nas/ 'jigs pa dang*/ bag tsha ba med par rnam par spyad do/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir mchod pa dang chu sbyin dang*/ sātstsha gdab pa la sogs pa bya ste/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /thams cad du gzhan la phan pa snying por bya'o/

/snang ba lha dang | rang bzhin stong pa dang*/ ngo bo zung du 'jug pa dang*/ kun tu spyod pa lha mchod pa'i thabs su shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa la ni/ don du mi 'gyur ba 'ga' yang med do/ /spyod lam gyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni/ brtson pa dang bstun pa'i bye brag gis 'di'am bar do la sogs par rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas/ sa dang lam rdzogs par byas te/ yon tan ma lus pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /thun mong gi dngos grub ni zhar la lhun gyis grub pa nyid do/ /gsang ba 'dus pa sbas chu'i rgya mtsho shin tu zab cing rgya che bar/ /ded dpon mtshungs med 'jam dbyangs mthu yis sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis ni/ /man ngag rin chen phung po blangs nas sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po yi/ /bang mdzod bsgrubs las rab tu btus nas rin chen phreng 'di kho bos spel/ /blo ldan gang zhig srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa ma lus kun bsal nas | | stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos sogs thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal gyis ni/ /rab tu 'byor zhing lha dang mi yi skyabs gnas dam par bya'o zhes | | nye bar khas 'che de dag gis ni rin chen phreng 'dis brgyan par gyis/ / dge ba gang zhig phul du byung ba'i 'bras bu nyer 'byin rin chen ltar/ /rnam par dag cing sdug bsngal mun nags tshang tshing rab 'joms 'od 'bar ba/ /nye bar bsags des thog med dus nas srid par dub pa dbugs phyung ste/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyi rtse mor kun bzang nor bus brgyan gyur cig /tshul 'di gang gi drin gyis rtogs gyur pa/ /srid gsum bla ma yon tan rin chen gter

| | chos rjai dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs/ chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis bkod pa'i kun tu bzang po'i bang mdzod las phyung nas/ bsdebs legs pa'i ngag gis rnam par spel ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos kyi rje mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos len pa/ lung dang rigs pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log par smra ba/ 'phags pa zhes bya bas me pho rta'i lo | dbyar zla 'bring po'i yar gyi ngo la/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang chen mor sbyar ba'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gnyis pa/ PAGE 612PAGE 611
